profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this accommodation and food service provider has experienced remarkable growth of 236.8% since its baseline, driven by its ability to deliver high-quality services to the local market. As a scaler in the industry, the company has expanded its workforce to 64 employees in 2024, indicating a significant increase in its operations and customer base. Its success can be attributed to its strategic location and effective service offerings, catering to the demands of the local hospitality sector.
